sections.title: Topics in Numerical Analysis and Scientific Computing
sections.description: Scientific computing involves leveraging computers to analyze and address scientific and engineering challenges. It often requires the development and analysis of new computational algorithms aimed at solving mathematical models, so that scientists can simulate physical processes and enhance their understanding of natural phenomena. In this course, we will introduce a series of fundamental or latest algorithms to understand the tools needed at the research level for various numerical methods for PDEs. Tentative topics include finite difference methods, spectral and pseudo-spectral methods, and neural network methods for solving ODEs/PDEs, and immersed boundary/interface methods for simulating fluid-structure interaction problems.
